stock.description: Best Linking Group Holdings Limited is a manufacturer and supplier of diverse mechanical parts and machinery, notably slewing rings. Their extensive product range includes essential components for excavators, such as undercarriage parts like track chains, rollers, and track shoes, as well as generators, chassis parts, engine parts, and various other accessories. The company operates under Original Brand Manufacturing (OBM), Original Design Manufacturing (ODM), and Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) models. Since its establishment in 2007, with headquarters in Kowloon, Hong Kong, the company has expanded its market reach to a wide array of countries, including the People's Republic of China, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Canada, Taiwan, the Philippines, New Zealand, Vietnam, Japan, Thailand, the United States, and Ireland.
